question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        im2.interest_name,
        MAX(im.composition) as max_composition,
        MAX(im.month_year) as max_month_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(im.composition) DESC) as rn_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(im.composition) ASC) as rn_asc
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map im2 ON CAST(im.interest_id AS BIGINT) = im2.id
    WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY im.interest_id, im2.interest_name
)
SELECT 
    max_month_year as time,
    interest_name,
    max_composition
FROM max_composition
WHERE rn_desc <= 10 OR rn_asc <= 10
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN rn_desc <= 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    max_composition DESC
